blocks.body: # StockPortfolio.pro — How to Get From ~$180 to $1,000

## Executive Summary
Nine real AppSumo orders produced $801 gross GMV and $183.97 in partner revenue with zero recorded refunds through 20 August. Seven orders redeemed; six redeemed buyers used Ask. AppSumo is the only proven transaction channel, but original discovery is known for only one buyer. The shortest evidence-constrained founder-proceeds test is seven genuinely new-to-AppSumo Tier 3 buyers through the portal's advertised 90% partner link—validated on the first order. Two Tier 3 orders already close the separate $1,000 gross-GMV target.

## What Current Buyers Actually Do
Completed Ask is the clearest observed post-purchase value action: six of seven redeemed buyers made 76 calls, but one Tier 3 buyer accounts for 54. Page telemetry is a lower bound because only four buyers have attributable page views. Only one buyer has an observable product journey before purchase, so the purchase aha moment remains unknown.

## Acquisition and Leakage
The latest AppSumo card shows 122 unique visitors, two orders and 1.64% conversion. That visitor-to-order step is the largest measured leak. X, Google and Bing generate clicks but no attributable customers; missing attribution means they are unproven, not necessarily uninfluential.

## Revenue Decision
Two more $149 Tier 3 orders take gross GMV from $801 to $1,099. Founder proceeds are harder: 24 more Tier 3 orders at the historical Tier 3 payout, 40 at the blended payout, or seven eligible new-to-AppSumo Tier 3 orders under an illustrative 10% discount and advertised 90% partner share. The first partner-link order is the economic gate.

## Recommendation
Sell the existing Tier 3 offer with one repeatable source-backed workflow: ask a company question, show the period and filing evidence, open the source, and state the limitation. Target serious US-equity researchers who are new to AppSumo. Do not delay the test for API, MCP, TradingView integration, more tools, broad SEO pages or a new pricing tier. Re-model immediately if the first referred order does not receive the advertised new-customer economics.

## Caveats
The cohort is only nine orders and seven redeemed users. Eight buyer discovery sources are unknown. AppSumo LTD behavior may not transfer to subscribers. One heavy Ask user distorts averages. GA4 current API access is blocked, Clarity is observational, search impressions are not commercial intent, and the 90% partner route has not yet produced an order. Every recommendation is a bounded experiment with a kill criterion, not a forecast.
